description: Flat metadata schema for individual soil sequencing records from agricultural fields, capturing soil properties, sampling context, nucleic acid extraction, sequencing, and processing information.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record or sample.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to a specific study or project.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the soil sample used for sequencing.

field_id.descr: Identifier for the agricultural field or site where the sample was collected.

replicate_id.descr: Replicate identifier for repeated sampling within the same field or treatment; use a consistent naming convention.

collection_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Time of sample collection, if available (24-hour local time).

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Sampling elevation above sea level in meters.

country.descr: Country where the field site is located.

region.descr: Administrative region/state/province/district of the sampling site.

site_description.descr: Free-text description of the sampling site or field context.

crop_type.descr: Dominant crop present at the time of sampling (e.g., maize, wheat, soybean).

agricultural_practice.descr: Primary agricultural management practice or treatment category (e.g., conventional, organic, no-till, crop rotation).

fertilizer_use.descr: Fertilizer regime applied to the field, including type or category if known.

pesticide_use.descr: Pesticide or herbicide application status or description.

irrigation_status.descr: Irrigation condition for the field, such as irrigated, rainfed, or mixed.

soil_type.descr: Soil classification or texture class, if known (e.g., loam, clay, sandy loam, USDA or FAO class).

soil_depth_cm.descr: Sampling depth in centimeters below the soil surface; use a single value if depth is discrete or a range in text form if needed.

soil_ph.descr: Soil pH measured using the stated extraction or suspension method.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content expressed as percent by mass or volumetric percent, as defined in the study.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Organic matter content of the soil expressed as percent.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at sampling in degrees Celsius, if measured.

soil_bulk_density_g_cm3.descr: Soil bulk density in grams per cubic centimeter, if measured.

sampling_method.descr: Description of the soil sampling approach (e.g., core, auger, composite sample, quadrat-based sampling).

sample_storage_condition.descr: Storage condition between collection and extraction (e.g., on ice, frozen at -80 C, RNAlater).

sample_transport_time_h.descr: Time from collection to laboratory processing or storage in hours, if known.

dna_rna_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid extracted from the sample (e.g., DNA, RNA, co-extracted DNA/RNA).

extraction_kit.descr: Name and/or manufacturer of the nucleic acid extraction kit or protocol used.

extraction_protocol.descr: Brief description or reference to the nucleic acid extraction protocol, including key modifications.

extraction_date.descr: Date nucleic acid extraction was performed, if available.

extraction_yield_ng_ul.descr: Concentration or yield of extracted nucleic acid in ng/µL, if measured.

quality_metric.descr: Primary nucleic acid quality metric used for downstream acceptance (e.g., A260/280, RIN, DIN).

quality_metric_value.descr: Numeric value of the nucleic acid quality metric.

target_region.descr: Sequenced target region or marker gene (e.g., 16S rRNA V3-V4, ITS1, shotgun metagenome).

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used before sequencing.

indexing_strategy.descr: Indexing/barcoding strategy used for multiplexing samples.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform or instrument used (e.g., Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore).

sequencing_chemistry.descr: Sequencing chemistry or flow cell version, if applicable.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for single-end reads or per read end for paired-end data.

sequencing_layout.descr: Sequencing layout category, such as single-end or paired-end.

lane_number.descr: Sequencing lane or run lane identifier, if applicable.

run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier assigned by the instrument or facility.

raw_data_accession.descr: Accession or file identifier for raw sequence data (e.g., SRA, ENA, DRA accession).

adapter_trimming_tool.descr: Software used for adapter or primer trimming.

quality_filter_tool.descr: Software used for sequence quality filtering.

merge_paired_reads_tool.descr: Software used to merge paired reads, if applicable.

chimera_removal_tool.descr: Software used to detect or remove chimeric sequences.

denoising_or_clustering_method.descr: Method used to infer sequence variants or OTUs (e.g., DADA2, Deblur, USEARCH clustering).

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic or functional assignment (e.g., SILVA, Greengenes, UNITE, KEGG).

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method used to assign taxonomy to sequences or ASVs/OTUs.

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method used for functional annotation, if applicable.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Name or version of the overall bioinformatics pipeline used for processing.

pipeline_version.descr: Version string for the bioinformatics pipeline or workflow.

software_versions.descr: Comma-separated list or free-text summary of key software names and versions used in processing.

normalization_method.descr: Method used to normalize counts or abundances before analysis (e.g., rarefaction, CSS, CLR, none).

contamination_control.descr: Description of negative controls, blank controls, or contamination mitigation steps.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of raw or filtered reads obtained for the sample.

retained_reads_reads.descr: Number of reads retained after filtering and processing, if applicable.

otu_asv_count.descr: Number of OTUs or ASVs inferred for the sample after processing.

diversity_metric_value.descr: Value of a diversity metric reported for the sample, if included in the metadata table.

diversity_metric_name.descr: Name of the diversity metric corresponding to the reported value (e.g., Shannon, Simpson, observed richness).

community_function_focus.descr: Main microbial community function or process of interest in the study (e.g., nitrogen cycling, carbon turnover, pathogen suppression).

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the sample, methods, or data interpretation.
